prompt.v: Angles p = (x + 37)⁠° and q = (5x + 17)⁠° are vertical angles. How big is p?

problems.text: angle equation: vertical, x + 37, 5x + 17, find x + 37
problems.explain: Vertical angles are equal, so set them equal: x + 37 = 5x + 17. Take x from both sides: 4x + 17 = 37. Take 17 from both sides: 4x = 20. Divide by 4: x = 5. That is x, not p: put it back in, p = 5 + 37 = 42. So p = 42°.
